name: copywriting-assistant-task-poc
description: E-commerce copywriting assistant — root scripts + frontend ESLint gate

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,warm -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run warm:next"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
